item.text:
I couldn’t save that revision. The validator allows only one value per arm and requires each value to match a source-supported quantitative tuple. It rejects repeated arm entries, and it also rejects a single value that combines the three separately reported rows.

The pending proposal remains unchanged. The figures are all available in the source—Grade 3: 277 (49%) vs 194 (35%); Grade 4: 38 (7%) vs 40 (7%); Grade 5: 6 (1%) vs 7 (1%)—but the validator currently has no accepted structure for storing them together per arm.
